body.heading: Sort by colour
paragraphs: Tip the buttons onto the tray. Pick one up and name its colour, then put it in its bowl.
Keep going until every button has found its colour family.

body.heading: Make the rainbow
paragraphs: Line the bowls up in rainbow order and count the buttons in each one.
Which colour won? Tip them back, shuffle, and the game is ready for tomorrow.

takeaway: Sorting is how your brain turns a jumble into a pattern.
materials: Small bowls or a muffin tin
safetyNotes: An adult checks the buttons are big, sorts with you, and keeps all buttons away from babies and toddlers.
screenFreeExtension: Sort the buttons a second way: by size, by number of holes, or by shiny and not shiny.
